SELECT skill.skill_code, skill.skill_name, skill.execution_mode, skill.scope AS skill_scope, version.id AS skill_version_id, version.version_no AS skill_version_no, ref.resource_version_id, resource_version.version_no AS tool_version_no, ref.usage, ref.status FROM data_agent_skill_tool_ref ref JOIN data_agent_skill_version version ON version.id = ref.skill_version_id AND version.deleted = false AND version.status = 'PUBLISHED' JOIN data_agent_skill skill ON skill.id = version.skill_id AND skill.deleted = false AND skill.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND skill.published_version_id = version.id JOIN agent_execution_resource_version resource_version ON resource_version.id = ref.resource_version_id AND resource_version.deleted = false WHERE ref.resource_key = #{resourceKey} AND ref.deleted = false AND LOWER(COALESCE(ref.status, 'enabled')) != 'disabled'
AND skill.scope = 'TENANT' AND skill.tenant_id = #{tenantId}
AND 1 = 0
ORDER BY skill.skill_code, version.version_no DESC, ref.display_order

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM data_agent_skill_tool_ref ref JOIN data_agent_skill_version version ON version.id = ref.skill_version_id AND version.deleted = false AND version.status = 'PUBLISHED' JOIN data_agent_skill skill ON skill.id = version.skill_id AND skill.deleted = false AND skill.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND skill.published_version_id = version.id WHERE ref.resource_key = #{resourceKey} AND ref.deleted = false AND LOWER(COALESCE(ref.status, 'enabled')) != 'disabled'
